# Installing the OADP Operator {#oadp-installing-operator-doc}

Install the {{ oadp_first }} Operator on OpenShift Container Platform 4.22 by using Operator Lifecycle Manager (OLM).

The {{ oadp_short }} Operator installs Velero {{ velero_version }}.

## Additional resources {#additional-resources_installing-oadp-operator}

- \[Velero {{ velero_version }}\](https://{{ velero_domain }}/docs/v{{ velero_version }}/)
